name: MacBook Air M3

name: MacBook Pro 14 M3
description: A powerful laptop with a bright screen. It handles video editing, design work and heavy coding without slowing down.

name: XPS 13

name: G15 Gaming

name: ThinkPad X1 Carbon

name: Yoga 7i

name: Spectre x360
description: A premium convertible with a sharp touch screen. It works well for design, presentations and normal study work.

name: Pavilion 15
description: An affordable laptop with a large screen. It is fine for browsing, documents and online classes on a small budget.

name: Zenbook 14
description: A thin laptop with a good screen and a fair price. It is fast enough for coding and light photo editing.

name: ROG Zephyrus G14
description: A small but strong gaming laptop. It is easy to carry and still runs games and heavy programs well.

name: Aspire 5
description: A simple and cheap laptop for basic work. It handles web pages, email and word processing without problems.

name: Swift 3
description: A light everyday laptop with a metal body. It is a good balance between price, speed and portability.

name: Katana 15
description: A gaming laptop with a fast processor and a large screen. It is best kept on a desk because the battery is short.

name: Surface Laptop 5
description: A clean and light laptop with a tall screen. It is comfortable for reading, writing and taking notes in class.

name: Surface Pro 9

name: Blade 15
description: A slim gaming laptop with a strong graphics card. It looks simple and works well for games and 3D design.

name: Galaxy Book3 Pro
description: A thin laptop with a very bright screen. It is made for photo and video work and still lasts a full study day.

name: Galaxy Book3 360
description: A convertible laptop with a touch screen and a stylus. It is useful for notes, sketches and normal school work.

name: Legion 5

name: Envy x360

name: Vivobook 15

name: Inspiron 14
description: A simple everyday laptop with a small screen. It is light enough to carry and covers the basic needs of a student.
